## Task

Implement PR 2 from parent issue #170: self-approval core. Use PR #166 as the reference implementation, but keep this slice limited to adding AGENT_ALLOW_SELF_APPROVE configuration/docs, the agent-self-approve route/prompt/workflow shell, structured verdict parsing, deterministic resolver logic, and PR-only/open/current-head checks. Build on the review-provenance helpers from PR #172. Do not add review -> agent-self-approve orchestration transitions, agent-self-approve -> fix-pr handoff behavior, delegated authorization changes beyond what is required for the route shell, status-upsert operational polish, or broad failure-visibility/artifact handling reserved for later slices. Preserve default behavior unless AGENT_ALLOW_SELF_APPROVE=true, and add focused tests for parser behavior, stale-head rejection, closed/non-PR/disabled-flag handling, and deterministic approval submission safeguards.
